::: {.callout-note}
## Coming Before The Semester Starts

Detailed setup instructions for Julia, VS Code, Git, and GitHub will be posted here before the first day of class. If you want to get a head start, the [Spring 2026 setup pages](https://envdata.viveks.me/spring2026/setup/) are a reasonable guide and little will change.
:::

## What You Will Need

- **Julia** (1.11 or later). We provide notebooks and package environments for Julia, and the course staff can best support you in it.
- **VS Code**, with the Julia extension.
- **Git and a GitHub account.** Mini projects are distributed as GitHub repositories that you fork, so you will need an account.

You are welcome to use another language --- R and Python are both perfectly reasonable for everything in this course --- but we may be limited in the programming help we can offer. We're happy to try.
